item.title: FreeWheel Unveils AI Agent Infrastructure, Powered by FreeWheel’s MCP Server
item.description: New MCP Server and Intelligence Tools automate negotiation, optimisation, and execution, advancing FreeWheel’s mission to modernise premium video transactions.

item.title: Nextdoor Launches AI-Powered Click Optimisation
item.description: Part of Nextdoor’s smart advertising suite expansion, the feature will provide advertisers with enhanced performance across the entire marketing funnel, improving CTR and driving deeper campaign engagement.

item.title: Stagwell Partners with AppLovin to Boost Mobile Advertising
item.description: In addition to enhanced reporting and optimisation tools, Stagwell clients will also receive platform support across setup and optimisation, creative best practices, and vertical-specific campaign execution.

item.title: Syndigo Acquires Taggstar to Power Dynamic PXM
item.description: Together, Syndigo and Taggstar enable brands and retailers to activate existing product data to create persuasive, revenue-driving experiences.

item.title: Giving Agents 100% Autonomy Will Only Lead to Failure
item.description: The algorithm can automatically discriminate against a potential customer due to outdated historical datasets. Post-campaign analysis can help identify biased decision-making and will enable revenue uplift, says Toju Duke, Founder & CEO, Diverse AI.

item.title: Anoki, Amagi Bring Scene-Level Intelligence to In-Content CTV Ads
item.description: The collaboration integrates Anoki’s ContextIQ with Amagi’s THUNDERSTORM SSAI solution to offer a seamless, non-disruptive way for advertisers to engage viewers during the scenes that matter most at scale.

item.title: Canva Introduces Magic Layers, Turning Static AI Outputs into Editable Designs
item.description: Magic Layers is a new capability within the Canva Design Model, the company’s proprietary foundation model, designed to generate designs that are editable from the start.

item.title: OpenX, TVision Launch Supply-Side Attention Targeting Solution for CTV
item.description: Powered by TVision, this new integration enables advertisers to reach the most engaged CTV audiences and improve campaign impact through pre-bid targeting.

item.title: Optable, PubMatic Partner for Agentic AI Activation
item.description: By integrating PubMatic AgenticOS with Optable’s identity-first, privacy-safe AI, buyers gain better signals and more efficient activation while complementing AgenticOS's execution capabilities with specialised audience intelligence.

item.title: Zendesk to Acquire Forethought to Expand Self-Improving AI Agents
item.description: Forethought AI agents by Zendesk will support more complex workflows, additional channels, and a wide range of service environments.
